aboutTaxonomy: CRediT is an ANSI/NISO standard (<cc>CC BY 4.0</cc>). This project is independent of NISO and not endorsed by it.
aboutPrivacy: Looking up an ORCID iD sends it to pub.orcid.org from your browser. Looking up a DOI sends it to api.crossref.org, together with this site's contact address, and to api.datacite.org if Crossref has no record. This site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is cookieless and counts visits in aggregate. Nothing else leaves your browser: drafts stay in its local storage.

welcomeBodyContributors: Paste a DOI to fill the whole list from the published record, or type names yourself. An ORCID iD fills a name in for you.
welcomeBodyRoles: Select cells in the grid to mark which of the 14 CRediT roles each contributor took on.

welcomeDraftsBody: Writing more than one paper? Switch drafts from the header; each is kept separately in this browser.
welcomeAskBody: Copy a link from a contributor's row menu and send it to them. When a link comes back, open it: it fills in that person's roles and nothing else.
importDescription: Start from a DOI, paste author names or a link a co-author sent back, or upload a CSV, JSON, or JATS4R XML file. JSON and XML restore contribution scores as well as names.
